classifier_boundary.advanced: identify_chord_from_pitches_advanced(pitches, bass_pitch=None, detected_key='E major') -> chord label string
classifier_boundary.input: MIDI integer pitches; simple classifier converts them to an unordered unique pitch-name set; advanced classifier converts them to pitch classes and uses bass plus its default E-major prior
classifier_boundary.loader: Exact AST-extracted classifier and local MIDI note-name function bodies
classifier_boundary.normalization: librosa-compatible C-major sharp spelling for integer MIDI notes
classifier_boundary.output: single internal chord label; neither function emits confidence or alternatives

confidence.semantic_meaning: A fixed downstream rule weight, not a classifier probability or calibrated correctness estimate.

decision_gate.reason: Results are mixed and need another isolated experiment before activation or replacement.

enharmonic_robustness.classifier_input: ordered MIDI integer pitches; spelling is not representable
enharmonic_robustness.interpretation: Enharmonic aliases collapse to the same MIDI input before either classifier runs; output spelling robustness is not tested by this interface.

limitations: No audio, BasicPitch, segmentation, temporal decoding, retrieval, or tutor logic is exercised.
Enharmonic input spelling cannot be represented by the MIDI-integer classifier interface.
The advanced scorer is evaluated offline with its existing default E-major prior and is not activated in production.
Classifier return branches and candidate score margins are not exposed by the current public functions.

enharmonic_mismatch.note: Not observable at the MIDI-integer classifier boundary; spelling is erased before classification.

fallback_misclassification.note: The public classifier returns only a label and does not expose which return branch fired.
